authority_name: UNESCO ICH public registry and named Yoruba custodial communities
community_context: Ifá as a living Yoruba divination and oral-knowledge tradition
permitted_scope: UNESCO public summary, safeguarding context and registry metadata
prohibited_scope: Full verse corpus, initiatory instruction, lineage-restricted interpretations and non-public ritual detail
attribution_requirement: Cite UNESCO and identify the public registry scope
permission_contact_or_process: Use named community/lineage authority for anything beyond the public page
policy_basis: Source scope plus project non-extraction rule
notes: A public URL does not make the whole tradition public domain.

permitted_scope: None in this public research pipeline
prohibited_scope: Secret verses, initiatory sequences, divination-client data, restricted ritual instructions and lineage-confidential interpretations
attribution_requirement: Not applicable because collection is prohibited
permission_contact_or_process: A separately authorized community-led project would be required; this database must not repurpose such permission
notes: Explicit hard stop for collection and storage.

authority_name: Relevant iwi/hapū authority for a named variant
permitted_scope: A public community-published account, or material supplied under explicit scoped permission
prohibited_scope: Unattributed pan-Māori synthesis, restricted whakapapa, sacred detail or reuse beyond consent
attribution_requirement: Name iwi/hapū, speaker/author, publication and permission scope
permission_contact_or_process: Obtain permission from the relevant authority for non-public or community-specific material
notes: Not all iwi share an Io tradition; variation is a first-class data property.

community_context: Restricted whakapapa or sacred community knowledge
permitted_scope: None unless a future community-led system explicitly changes the storage model
prohibited_scope: Restricted genealogies, sacred knowledge and material whose publication status or authority is unclear
attribution_requirement: Not applicable because collection is prohibited by default
permission_contact_or_process: Do not solicit or store; refer to community authority

authority_name: Te Ahukaramū Charles Royal / Te Ara
community_context: Public, named, curated synthesis of Māori creation traditions
permitted_scope: Public text under stated CC BY-NC terms, with author and source attribution
prohibited_scope: Generalizing the synthesis as every iwi/hapū version; reusing non-text media without checking its terms
attribution_requirement: Attribute Te Ahukaramū Charles Royal and Te Ara; preserve page licence limits
permission_contact_or_process: Commercial reuse or non-text media requires the stated source process
policy_basis: Te Ara citation and licence notice
notes: Public synthesis explicitly says tribes have different versions.

authority_name: Metropolitan Museum of Art for object metadata; Yoruba custodians for living meaning
community_context: Museum object metadata and living religious context are separate authority layers
permitted_scope: Catalogue number, material, dimensions, custody and museum-published interpretation
prohibited_scope: Image reuse outside terms, secret ritual use or treating a museum object as exhaustive community authority
attribution_requirement: Cite catalogue and distinguish curator interpretation from community authority
permission_contact_or_process: Seek custodial authority for non-public living-practice claims
policy_basis: Museum catalogue scope plus living-tradition distinction

authority_name: Oyo Ṣàngó Festival communities and UNESCO ICH public registry
community_context: Publicly documented festival and safeguarding context
permitted_scope: Official public festival description, inscription decision and public safeguarding information
prohibited_scope: Non-public rites, restricted spaces, participant personal data and claims of authority not stated by custodians
attribution_requirement: Cite UNESCO record and name Oyo community context
permission_contact_or_process: Refer non-public questions to authorized Oyo institutions/custodians
policy_basis: Source terms and living-tradition attribution rule
notes: Public festival visibility does not erase ritual boundaries.

community_context: Non-public ritual and interior community knowledge
permitted_scope: Only material specifically released by an authorized custodian for the stated use
prohibited_scope: Secret or restricted rites, interior locations, unconsented participant data and generalized Yoruba-wide claims
attribution_requirement: Record named authority, scope and date of permission per claim
permission_contact_or_process: Obtain explicit purpose-specific permission before collection
notes: No permission is inferred from museum or UNESCO publication.
